0001-hicache-openssl-fallback.patch.reason: HiCache storage backends JIT-build hash_binding.cpp against OpenSSL, and the CUDA images ship no headers and no unversioned libcrypto.so, so the build fails and the server exits. Fall back to the interpreter prefix when the system headers are absent.

0002-ipc-tuple-get.patch.reason: The cuda_ipc JIT extension does not compile against tvm_ffi 0.1.9: Array's const iterator yields a const Tuple, and the free get<I> overloads fail to resolve on it. The build failure is non-fatal, so custom allreduce is silently disabled and every run falls back to NCCL. Take the element by value and use the member get<I>().

0003-qpn2-marlin-moe-shape.patch.reason: fused_marlin_moe asserts the Marlin weight layout before it calls moe_wna16_marlin_gemm, which is the only seam sglang-restomod replaces, so a QPN2 expert bank can never reach the QPN2 reader. Derive E/K/N from the bank when w1 is a uint8 QPN2 tensor, and gate the path to the NVFP4, single-rank, gated envelope.

0005-sm70-deepgemm-env-defaults.patch.reason: The platform block in model_hook.py turns DeepGEMM-only knobs off for sm120 and for hip and has no arm for Volta, so on sm70 the defaults select paths that need deep_gemm, which configurer.py leaves unimported below sm90. Four writes, each with a reachable consumer read at the pin: DEEPGEMM_HC_PRENORM False (deepseek_v4 HC prenorm dispatch above 1024 prefill tokens, else hc_pre_torch_impl), FP8_PAGED_MQA_LOGITS_TORCH True (indexer.py nonpaged gather imports deep_gemm; the paged torch path also vetoes the nonpaged route), USE_TILELANG_MHC_PRE False and USE_TILELANG_MHC_POST False (skips the split-K prewarm that refuses hc_hidden_size other than 16384/28672, and routes to hc_pre_torch_impl / post_torch_impl). All guarded by is_set() like the sm120 arm; FP8_WO_A_GEMM is deliberately absent because serving_hook.py:475-495 already unsets it when the runtime cannot run it.

0006-mhc-prenorm-block-selection.patch.reason: mhc_pre's split-K path selects hidden_block from a two-entry table of hc_hidden_size values (16384->256, 28672->128) and raises for anything else, so _prewarm_mhc_kernels in load_weights aborts any DeepSeek-V4 model whose hc_mult*hidden_size is another size -- V4.1-Flash-1017 is 4*5120=20480. The kernel is generic: mhc_pre_gemm_sqrsum_splitk_kernel asserts only that split_size = hc_hidden_size//split_k divides by hidden_block, and the two entries are the largest candidate block that divides (512->256, 896->128). Select the largest of {256,128} that divides split_size and raise a message naming hc_hidden_size, split_k and split_size when none does. SM70 caveat, measured 2026-11-16: the generalized selection reaches the kernel but TileLang cannot compile it on Volta -- tilelang/tileop/gemm/gemm_mma_sm70.py:44 -> intrinsics/mma_sm70_macro_generator.py:359 make_mma_load_layout raises 'ValueError: Unsupported dtype float32', because this GEMM's fn operand is fp32 and the sm70 MMA macro generator has no fp32 load layout. So this patch is correct for other architectures and unusable on sm70; the SM70 route is the torch fallback that 0005 selects.

0007-dsv4-lazy-flash-mla.patch.reason: DeepseekV4AttnBackend.__init__ imports flash_mla_interface under `if is_cuda():`, and flash_mla is built only for the architectures it targets, so on sm70 the import raises ModuleNotFoundError at construction -- before any subclass can replace the decode path. All three --dsv4-attn-backend choices subclass this class, so no flag avoids it. Defer the import: compute the SWA layout unconditionally, resolve flash_mla inside a try and, when absent, bind a callable that raises a named error at the terminal call instead of a ModuleNotFoundError at construction. Behaviour is unchanged wherever flash_mla exists.
